primary.title: How to Set Up Finances in ChatGPT
primary.summary: Finances in ChatGPT can help you get a clearer picture of your spending and find ways to make progress toward your financial goals. In this video, we'll get you up to speed with the basics of Finances in ChatGPT: connect your bank account, review your recurring subscriptions, and build a budget around what matters to you. primary.title: Experiment with SVG & 3D Design with the Codex Plugin
primary.summary: Craig Dennis had never drawn an SVG by hand or used Blender. With the SVG & 3D Design plugin for Codex, he shows how to turn a reference image into an editable graphic or 3D model, then ask for changes in plain language. See how a small change in SVG code can make a character’s eyes follow your cursor, and how Codex uses Blender to check a model from another angle. Enable SVG & 3D Design in Codex and tell us what you build! primary.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
primary.summary: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look. https://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/

primary.title: The brain helped us build AI. Now AI is explaining the brain.
primary.summary: The human brain remains one of the greatest unsolved mysteries in science. We have roughly 86 billion neurons firing in a way that somehow produces intelligence, and yet the brain is still largely a black box. In the early days of AI, researchers looked to the brain for clues about how to build smarter machines. But today, that relationship has been flipped on its head. Join Professor Hannah Fry and neuroscience researchers Maria Eckstein and Kim Stachenfeld to see how scientists are using AI to better understand the human mind. 00:00 Introduction 01:11 Using AI to understand the brain 10:14 E

primary.title: How to Fine-Tune Models Beyond Cosmos With NVIDIA Cosmos Framework
primary.summary: NVIDIA Cosmos Framework now supports fine-tuning models beyond the Cosmos family. In this tutorial, learn how to fine-tune Qwen3-VL for robot video question answering with NVIDIA Cosmos Framework and agent skills. Follow the RoboVQA recipe from environment setup and data preparation through preflight checks, baseline evaluation, training, and model export. See how a coding agent runs the workflow from a single prompt, then compare the base and fine-tuned models’ answers on a held-out robot clip.
